title: Dice Probability Calculator
description: For XdY plus a modifier get the full exact probability distribution, P(≥ target) and the mean.
howto: Enter dice X, sides Y, modifier and target.
Read the success chance and the full distribution table.

faqs.a: Dynamic programming convolves one die at a time — exact counts for every total, no Monte Carlo sampling.
The cumulative chance of rolling at least that total — the number that matters for attack rolls and saving throws.
One die averages (Y+1)/2; X independent dice add their means, then the modifier shifts everything.
